title: Wanderlane Traveller Club Status Match and Challenge Terms
content:
A status held with another programme may be matched into a tier of the Wanderlane Traveller Club only where that tier permits matching. Where it does, the matched member is given a challenge: a number of calendar days in which to earn the tier outright, and the number of tier-qualifying points that must be earned inside those days to keep the matched tier.

## Terms by tier

| Basis | Blue | Silver | Gold | Platinum | Titanium | Ambassador |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Matching permitted | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No |
| Challenge (calendar days) | 0 | 90 | 90 | 120 | 0 | 0 |
| Challenge (qualifying points) | 0 | 6000 | 15000 | 30000 | 0 | 0 |

## The same terms stated tier by tier

- Wanderlane Blue does not permit matching, and its challenge stands at 0 days and 0 qualifying points.
- Wanderlane Silver permits matching, on a challenge of 90 calendar days and 6000 qualifying points.
- Wanderlane Gold permits matching, on a challenge of 90 calendar days and 15000 qualifying points.
- Wanderlane Platinum permits matching, on a challenge of 120 calendar days and 30000 qualifying points.
- Wanderlane Titanium does not permit matching, and its challenge stands at 0 days and 0 qualifying points.
- Wanderlane Ambassador does not permit matching, and its challenge stands at 0 days and 0 qualifying points.
